question: Ryder Cup is associated with ________ sport.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golf.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ryder Cup is a biennial men's golf competition between teams from Europe and the United States.**
 
• It is named after English businessman** Samuel Ryder **who donated the trophy.
 
• The competition has been held since 1927 and is one of the most prestigious events in golf.
 
• The format of the competition includes various match play formats such as** foursomes and singles matches.**
 
• The Ryder Cup has a rich history and is known for its intense competition and passionate fans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cycling:**

 
 
• Cycling is a sport that involves riding bicycles for racing, recreation, or transportation.
 
• The most prestigious cycling event is the Tour de France, which is a multi-stage race held annually.
 
• Cycling has been an Olympic sport since the first modern Olympics in 1896.
 
 
 
• **Cricket:**
 
 
• Cricket is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of eleven players. 
 
• It is the second most popular sport in the world after soccer.
 
• Cricket is most popular in countries such as India, England, Australia, South Africa, and the West Indies.
 
 
 
• **Swimming:**
 
 
• Swimming is a sport that involves moving through water using one's body.
 
• It is a popular sport in the Olympics and has various disciplines such as freestyle, breaststroke, and butterfly.
 
• Swimming is also a popular recreational activity and is often used for fitness and therapy.
